testedSource.basis: Canonical LF for text; exact binary assets. Identity is not semantic parity.

tests.skipExplanation: The offscreen WebView case has a passing Windows counterpart. Any workspace-tree link case listed as skipped requires Windows symbolic-link privilege; it is not counted as tested.

coveredChanges: An explicit interruption of a pending question takes priority over older queued messages (question-priority stage).
Workbench shortcuts are suppressed while Settings is shown and restored after Back, including compact layout (settings-shortcuts stage).

Rich Markdown links, link titles, incomplete streaming links, references and fences render through shared TranscriptText normalization; diff previews no longer report false clipping at exactly 1200 rows.

Hidden or restored browser tabs initialize for authorized agent requests without forced show/focus/select; a ready visible tab is never held for its first navigation; startup waiters fail only on initialization errors; never-shown tabs get a content-area viewport.
limits: The701-row scope and17331-function reference index remain preserved. Full semantic, line-by-line, pixel and identical reasoning parity is not established.
All live and packaged GUI claims remain historical until this exact new binary is separately exercised.

Hidden tabs are sized from the nearest visible ancestor (content area including the navigation bar height); screenshots of hidden tabs and the 2MiB UTF16 screenshot transport fallback (B6) remain open; per-agent tab strips (B2) are not implemented.

Single-instance focus IPC, notification/keep-awake runtime consumers, history retry/edit/revert, background unread/error status and native search gitignore parity remain in progress outside this cohort.

Code-block line numbers emphasize the current line, unlike upstream uniform numbering; the trailing empty numbered line after a final newline matches upstream Shiki/fallback line splitting and is not a defect.
Cursor actual login/inference and remote services without credentials remain unverified; synthetic tests establish only their stated contract.
